scoreRationale.onboarding: Current G2 feedback repeatedly praises the clean interface, easy setup, and direct path from time tracking to an invoice, supporting an 8.6 score.
scoreRationale.product: FreshBooks handles invoices, time, expenses, payments, and core reports well for service firms, but reviewers flag weaker inventory, search, and report customization, supporting 8.1.
scoreRationale.support: Several G2 reviewers praise access to helpful human support, though Digital Macaroni did not test support directly; that mix supports 7.6.
scoreRationale.billing: Published regular prices are clear, but five- and 50-client caps plus $11 monthly team seats make growth expensive, supporting 6.9.
scoreRationale.overall: FreshBooks is a strong, approachable billing tool for freelancers and service firms, but its client caps, add-ons, and accounting limits reduce long-term value, supporting 7.8.

conflictsAndUnknowns: Third-party review sources inaccessible (G2, Capterra, Trustpilot)
